svg.text: in two lengths joined with a socket.

svg.text: Bend: 90 degrees, 120 mm radius, threaded or welded.

svg.text: Riser: about 1.8 m, so the outlet is 2.4 m above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded to the riser top: rain kept out, gas let out.
